description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class, which provides static utility functions for working with JsonObject instances, including checking for boolean and string entries, creating JSON objects from boolean values, and serializing boolean values to strings.
external_files: JsonObject (likely part of WPEFramework or a similar framework)
Core::JSON::Variant (from the Core namespace, part of JSON handling library)

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating, checking, and serializing JSON objects related to boolean and string entries.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a boolean entry under the specified key and retrieves its value.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representation of a boolean value associated with a key.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a single boolean entry for the given key and value.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to an existing JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a string entry under the specified key and retrieves its value.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value into its string representation 'true' or 'false'.
